# ProVA Hiring Tracker

> A hiring pipeline tracker: add candidates, move them through stages, rate
> them, keep interview notes, and search the pipeline. All data lives in the
> visitor's own browser (localStorage); there is no backend and no account.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what the tracker does, with a preview of the board.
- [Hiring board](/hire): the application itself — pipeline board, list view,
  candidate detail panel with notes and ratings.

## Notes for agents

- The board is client-rendered after hydration; candidate data is per-browser
  and never leaves the device, so there is nothing to crawl beyond the shell.
- Source: https://github.com/davidojo1144/ProVa
